findings.basis: Each actual installed version matches the current upstream stable release. Newer observed Codex/RTK tags are prereleases; no demonstrated requirement justifies replacing accepted native behavior.

components.finding: The current stable patch disables default reasoning summaries in new local TUI sessions to avoid rejection by providers without support, while preserving explicit settings. Installed version includes it.

The current stable release fixes whole-window reporting, retrieval-access accounting, 99.9-percent display precision and subagent per-turn cost attribution. Installed native Codex, Desktop and Claude packages all match.

The stable release contains content-addressed/SQLite recall and per-filter recall telemetry. Existing practice already uses recall/raw recovery and explicit Codex commands; prerelease recency does not establish an automatic Codex hook fix.

Stable notes cover session-aware compression, protect file reads against lossy Responses-path compression, and avoid garbling mixed subagent output. Existing guarded artifact and tested native MCP lanes remain separate from provider-proxy adoption. GitHub's current canonical repository is headroomlabs-ai/headroom; older chopratejas link redirects.

Stable CLI fixes preserve stdout for data, put diagnostics on stderr, terminate file output with newline and correct comment/BOM parsing. Existing conditional use and compact-JSON counterexample remain applicable.

findings.metadata_followup: Prefer the canonical Headroom repository URL when next updating the selected source record; this is source-link maintenance, not a missing runtime capability.
limitations: This is a dated read-only release/source review, not fresh provider use or a universal tool-quality ranking.
